author: Yffe
content: Critic pin of the OQ-2 divergence: commit the failing-test artifact (forge/tests/divergence_degrade_oq2_pending.rs.pending) documenting that kani::is_under_bound_failure's bare 'unwind' substring arm degrades a real L2 counterexample to L1. The runnable test targets a private symbol of the binary-only forge crate, so it lands inside kani.rs mod tests with the fixer's one-line fix (drop the || d.contains("unwind") arm). No production code edited by the critic.
